dimensions.name: native_default
dimensions.description: Clear work is answered or executed directly. Importance, complexity, risk, a missing concrete parameter, or the availability of a Skill does not by itself force a workflow.

dimensions.name: epistemic_honesty
dimensions.description: The result distinguishes observation, inference, unknown, and completed work, and never claims an unperformed method, tool call, test, effect, installation, or host behavior.

dimensions.name: proportional_evidence
dimensions.description: Verification and defenses match credible risk and the claim made. Direct outcome evidence is preferred; tests and hashes can support but never replace semantic correctness.

dimensions.name: routing_precision
dimensions.description: Collaborate handles explicit joint thinking or materially unformed preference; Research handles broad or deep external multi-source work; Debug handles unknown cause; Plan handles a selected direction; Review handles a stable candidate; Goal requires explicit persistence; Init is project-local; Update is global. Explorer remains an internal agent.

dimensions.name: role_isolation
dimensions.description: Researcher, Explorer, Debugger, Challenger, Planner, Reviewer, Worker, and Writer keep their named responsibilities. Challenger is strict adversarial only, Reviewer also reviews plans, and an unavailable required role is reported rather than impersonated.

dimensions.name: live_document
dimensions.description: A reusable task has one live document. Writer creates it at the first reusable content, updates it only for material evidence, decision, conclusion, or next-step changes, and finalizes it without altering facts, decisions, authority, or completion.

dimensions.name: semantic_pairs
dimensions.description: Every public Skill has a positive routing case and a nearby negative control whose expected route differs. Pair correctness is semantic and does not depend on fixed inventory counts or digest ceremony.

dimensions.name: release_evidence
dimensions.description: Static, installed-semantic, disposable-write, and dry-run evidence are reported separately. Static, installed-semantic, and disposable-write must pass for release-ready; NOT RUN, UNSUPPORTED, and FAIL remain blockers in required lanes.
